visualScreening.observation: Loading UI precedes room view; female film briefly shows initial close preset before QA room trace. This is setup, not tracked-chain camera drift.

Walking, reversal, approach and seated transition are present; complete head/trunk/arms/legs remain visible in sampled poses. No whole-garment disappearance observed. Foot sliding and single-frame transitions are not accepted from 2FPS.

Grey microphone mesh/handle seen in seated-speaking reference is absent after unload; left hand rises for greeting then returns. Navy collar silhouette near face remains and must not be confused with a leftover microphone. Fine finger trajectories cannot be assessed at this scale.
Forward lean, rise and departure are visible; no persistent seated lock or missing limb observed. This view does not clear known palm/skirt intersections.

Reference loop, technical raised-arm/leg poses, completion and replay/interruption are represented. End samples return arms toward locomotion/idle instead of remaining in the raised dance pose. Repetition/phase aliasing at2FPS prevents judging rhythm, smoothness or professional dance quality.
Walking after interruption and final idle appear with the selected outfit retained; no loose detached outfit mesh or visibly stuck raised arm in sampled tail.
